summary: Powerfleet, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, announcing a board-authorized stock repurchase program. The company may repurchase up to $30 million of its common stock over 24 months through open market or private transactions under Rule 10b-18. No price per share, premium, or specific shares are obligated; repurchases depend on market conditions, legal requirements, lender consent, and the company's financial health. The program can be modified or suspended at any time. Watch for any actual buyback execution or adjustments, as this signals capital allocation but lacks firm commitment.
